reviews.text: It is pretty glowy and dewy. Sadly, the color does not last more than 30 minutes on the lips. I think it lasts longer on the cheeks. Anyway, I like the color and I like it overall.
reviews.zh: 水光感同 dewy 感都幾明顯。遺憾係，顏色喺唇上 keep 唔到超過 30 分鐘。我覺得喺面頰上反而持久啲。Anyway，我鍾意呢個顏色，整體都好鍾意。

reviews.text: I personally like my makeup more natural so I tend to put on less pigments. Just 1 small dab of this is light and sheer and I love it! You can definitely build more color and layers with this and it leaves a nice and dewy/glowy blush on your cheeks. I got the 16 Bare Dew and it's super pretty and looks natural. Looks really good on lips and cheeks!
reviews.zh: 我自己比較鍾意自然妝感，所以習慣落少啲色。一小點就已經好 light 好通透，我好鍾意！可以疊加顏色同層次，喺面頰留低好好睇嘅 dewy／glowy 胭脂效果。我買咗 16 Bare Dew，超靚好自然。搽喺唇上面頰都好好睇！

reviews.text: Using pretty good amount of the product will help to see the color on the lips. The little lip brush helps a lot. Only thing I don’t like about this ball concept is the lid. It’s so inconvenient to open and close…
reviews.zh: 用返足夠份量先見到唇上嘅顏色。支細細嘅唇刷幫助好大。呢個球狀設計我最唔鍾意就係個蓋。開開關關超麻煩……

reviews.text: A waste of money , sticky , can’t use as lipgloss , color not pigmented, won’t buy again
reviews.zh: 嘥錢，又黏，唔可以做唇 gloss 用，顏色唔顯色，唔會再買。

reviews.text: Listen, I just bought this for the keychain brush, but it is a nice formula. The packaging is a little big to carry in my purse, but it is nice to use to prep my lips before makeup. The color on the cheeks is a lot more vibrant in person and doesn't show up on camera, but too sticky for me. Also the color doesn't show up on my lips at all unless I put foundation on them, which with this product kind of defeats the purpose of it for me :(
reviews.zh: 講真，我買佢淨係為咗支鎖匙扣 brush，但佢嘅 formula 係唔錯嘅。包裝對我個袋嚟講有少少大，但用嚟妝前打底唇就 ok。顏色上面頰嘅實物效果好 vibrant 過鏡頭，但對我嚟講太黏。而且唇上完全唔見到顏色，除非事先喺唇上搽 foundation，但用呢件產品仲要另外搽 foundation 就有啲本末倒置 :(

reviews.text:
The colour so pretty💗 Can use on the cheek and on the lips
And the texture so nice, look glowy and non sticky
The skin look so glowy, love this product so much
reviews.zh: 顏色超靚💗 面頰唇上都用得。質地好好，水光得嚟又唔黏。皮膚望落好 glowy，超鍾意呢件產品。

reviews.text: This just somehow works effectively for both the cheeks and the lips. It’s glossy enough for the lips but looks natural without excess shine when applied to the face. It’s slightly tacky like lip gloss but hair doesn’t stick to the face when applied to the cheeks. Just amazing. I would use it more often if it was in a different container.
reviews.zh: 唔知點解呢件嘢面頰唇兩邊都用得到。唇上面夠 glossy，但搽上面就自然得嚟唔會太光。質感有少少 tacky 好似唇 gloss，但搽上面頰就唔黐頭髮。簡直完美。如果個容器唔係咁我會用得更密。

reviews.text: These balms are very hydrating and more pigmented than I thought they’d be. They have such a nice selection of colors and the formula is not sticky at all. The formula is really similar to the AOU balms.
reviews.zh: 呢啲 balm 非常保濕，顯色度亦比我想像中強。顏色選擇好多，formula 完全唔黏。Formula 同 AOU 嘅 balm 真係好似。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
